hero.title: Bathurst
hero.subtitle: Australia's Oldest Inland City
hero.description: Discover the best accommodation in Bathurst — from charming heritage stays to modern motels. Explore Mount Panorama, gold rush history, world-class wineries, and stunning countryside.

whyVisit.title: Why Stay in Bathurst?
whyVisit.description: Whether you're seeking accommodation in Bathurst for the Bathurst 1000, a wine getaway, or a heritage exploration — this historic city has it all.

mountPanorama.title: Mount Panorama
mountPanorama.description: Home to the legendary Bathurst 1000 motor race. Drive the iconic circuit or soak in panoramic views of the city below.

goldRush.title: Gold Rush Heritage
goldRush.description: Step back to the 1850s gold rush era. Visit historic goldfields, heritage-listed buildings, and museums that tell Bathurst's rich story.

wineries.title: Award-Winning Wineries
wineries.description: The cool-climate Orange and Mudgee wine regions are at your doorstep. Enjoy cellar door tastings and gourmet dining experiences.

central.title: Central Location
central.description: Just 3 hours from Sydney by car or train. The perfect base to explore the stunning Central West NSW region and Blue Mountains.

attractionsHome.title: Top Bathurst Attractions
attractionsHome.description: From the iconic Mount Panorama to gold rush history and world-class wineries — Bathurst offers unforgettable experiences for every traveller.

mountPanorama.title: Mount Panorama Circuit
mountPanorama.description: The world-famous motor racing circuit and home of the Bathurst 1000. Drive the 6.2km public road or visit the National Motor Racing Museum.

courthouse.title: Historic Bathurst Courthouse
courthouse.description: One of Australia's finest heritage courthouses. Explore the stunning sandstone architecture and learn about Bathurst's colonial past.

gardens.title: Machattie Park & Gardens
gardens.description: Beautiful Victorian-era gardens in the heart of Bathurst featuring ornamental lakes, heritage bandstand, and stunning native plantings.

goldfields.title: Bathurst Goldfields
goldfields.description: Relive the excitement of the 1850s gold rush. Pan for gold, explore heritage buildings, and discover the stories of the fortune seekers.

wineries.title: Central West Wineries
wineries.description: Sample award-winning cool-climate wines from the nearby Orange and Mudgee wine regions. Perfect for a day trip from your Bathurst accommodation.

activities.title: Popular Activities Near Bathurst
activities.description: Whether you're looking for adventure, culture, or relaxation — there's no shortage of things to do during your stay in Bathurst, NSW.

race.title: Bathurst 1000 Race Weekend
race.description: Experience the thrill of Australia's greatest motor race. Book accommodation in Bathurst early — the entire region fills up fast during the October long weekend.

gold.title: Gold Panning Experience
gold.description: Try your luck panning for gold at the Bathurst Goldfields heritage site. A fun hands-on activity for the whole family.

wine.title: Wine & Food Trail
wine.description: Explore the Central West wine trail with cellar door tastings at boutique wineries, local produce markets, and gourmet restaurants.

heritage.title: Heritage Walking Tours
heritage.description: Discover Bathurst's 200+ years of history with self-guided or guided walking tours through the city's beautifully preserved heritage precinct.

caves.title: Abercrombie Caves
caves.description: Explore the stunning Abercrombie Caves, featuring the largest natural limestone arch in the southern hemisphere. Just 70km south of Bathurst.

balloon.title: Scenic Hot Air Ballooning
balloon.description: Float gently over the breathtaking Central West countryside at sunrise. An unforgettable way to see the region from above.

booking.title: Book Bathurst Adventures
booking.description: Browse and book the best tours, activities, and experiences in and around Bathurst.

accommodationPage.title: Bathurst Accommodation Types
accommodationPage.description: From budget motels to luxury hotels, camping under the stars to cosy B&Bs — find the perfect place to stay for your Bathurst adventure.

race.title: 🏁 Race Week
race.text: Book 6–12 months ahead for the Bathurst 1000 in October. Minimum stays and premium pricing apply across all accommodation types.

offPeak.title: 🍂 Off-Peak
offPeak.text: Visit March–May or September–November for the best weather and availability. Prices drop significantly outside event weekends.

location.title: 📍 Location
location.text: Stay within 10 minutes of town for easy access to attractions, dining, and Mount Panorama. Shuttle services run during major events.

accommodationPage.exploreDesc: Discover what to see, do, and experience during your stay.
accommodationPage.faqSubtitle: Common questions about finding places to stay in Bathurst.

motels.title: Motels
motels.subtitle: Budget to mid-range comfort
motels.description: Bathurst has around 20 motels spread across the city, many within a short drive of Mount Panorama. Motels are the most popular choice for race-goers and weekend visitors, offering clean, comfortable rooms with parking right at your door.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.subtitle: Full-service stays
hotels.description: For those wanting more amenities, Bathurst's hotels offer restaurants, bars, room service, and conference facilities. Rydges Mount Panorama is the premium option, located right at the circuit with mountain views.
hotels.bestFor: Business travellers, couples, families wanting comfort

caravan.title: Caravan Parks & Camping
caravan.subtitle: Outdoor adventure
caravan.description: Bathurst's caravan parks are a social hub, especially during race week. Choose from powered sites, unpowered sites, and cabins. Some parks are walking distance from Mount Panorama, and the camping atmosphere is part of the Bathurst experience.

airbnb.title: Airbnb & Private Rentals
airbnb.subtitle: Home away from home
airbnb.description: The rise of Airbnb has added significant capacity, especially during peak events. Find everything from studio apartments to full houses with backyards. Great for groups who want to spread out and self-cater.

bnb.title: Bed & Breakfasts
bnb.subtitle: Charming hospitality
bnb.description: Bathurst and the surrounding countryside have some lovely B&Bs offering personal hospitality, home-cooked breakfasts, and heritage character. Ideal for couples looking for a romantic getaway or a quieter alternative to motels.
